readout_other: Tail movement recorded with a piezoelectric pulse transducer
direction_notes: Sonication of the motor area elicited tail movements synchronised with the 2-s sonication intervals in all animals.

exposures.label: 350 kHz pulsed FUS to rat motor cortex (tail area) with image-guided navigation

target.label: the motor area of the rat brain

timing.protocol_description: Pulse-repetition frequency of 1 kHz, tone-burst duration of 0.5 ms, sonication duration of 300 ms and a sonication interval of 2 s, delivered to the site about 2 mm posterior to bregma on the midline.

source_quotes.n_subjects: For the neuromodulatory experiment, the rat $( n = 3 , 2 7 2 - 3 5 9 \mathrm { ~ g ) }$ was anesthetized with an intraperitoneal injection of a ketamine/ xylazine mixture of 80:10 mg/kg.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The single element FUS transducer used in this study was air-backed and of a segmented sphere shape (6 cm in diameter, 7 cm in ROC), operating in 350 kHz in fundamental frequency.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: Considering the ultrasound attenuation factor (-87%) through the rodent skull in situ (Kinoshita et al., 2006), the resulting $I _ { \mathrm { s p p a } }$ was 9.1 $\mathrm { W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 }$ and the corresponding mechanical index (MI) was 0.9 (where peak negative pressure was 0.5 MPa).
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.isppa_w_cm2: Considering the ultrasound attenuation factor (-87%) through the rodent skull in situ (Kinoshita et al., 2006), the resulting $I _ { \mathrm { s p p a } }$ was 9.1 $\mathrm { W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 }$ and the corresponding mechanical index (MI) was 0.9 (where peak negative pressure was 0.5 MPa).
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.ispta_w_cm2: The equivalent spatial-peak temporal-average intensity $( I _ { \mathrm { s p t a } } )$ was calculated as 4.5 $\mathrm { { W / c m } } ^ { 2 }$ with 50% of duty factor.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: The bursts of pulsed waves were generated by two successive function generators (33210A, Agilent, Santa Clara, CA) at the pulse-repetition frequency of 1 kHz, toneburst duration of 0.5 ms, sonication duration of 300 ms, and sonication interval of 2 s, and transmitted to the transducer through a linear power amplifier (240L, ENI Inc., Rochester, NY).

source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: The FUS focus generated by the segmented-sphere piezoelectric ultrasound transducer (Sonomo, SensMed, Framingham, MA) is located along the center axis away from the inner surface of the transducer, as defined by the inner radius-of-curvature (ROC), according to the manufacturing specification (7 cm).
